For q-114399 and q-79197, second-derivative sign changes occur at (-1,1) and (1,3), respectively; touching the axis at -3 or -2 does not change concavity. For q-114409, f''=2(1-x^2)/(1+x^2)^2 changes sign at both ±1. For q-114407, g''=e^x x^2(x-2) changes sign only at 2. For q-40334, P=x^2(x+1)(x-2)>0 outside [-1,2]. For q-116407, the cubic is negative on (-∞,-3) and (0,2). For q-89882, y''=-y'/y^2+1/x evaluates to 0. For q-89880, y''=y(1-2x)/x^4 evaluates to -2. For q-88308, dividing by the positive exponential gives x^2>12. Substitution u=x^2 gives 5 for q-13751; u=x^2-7 gives 7^(x^2-7)/(2 ln 7)+C for q-73802. The Euler updates are 2+1·6=8 and e^2+(1/2)·4=e^2+2. For q-121322, the squared factor is positive in all four regions, so the signs are (+,-; +,-). For q-326436, multiplying the signs of -x^3 and y+1 gives (+,-; -,+). For q-149553, x(2-y)>0 means x<0,y>2 or x>0,y<2; current image option 2 shows these regions and matches the source solution image despite its different filename.
